entries.title: Psalms 56:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to aJonath elem rehokim. A Psalm of David. Michtam: when the Philistines took him in Gath.>> Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:2
segments: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:3
segments: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 56:4
segments: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 56:5
segments: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.

entries.title: Psalms 56:6
segments: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 56:7
segments: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 56:8
segments: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?

entries.title: Psalms 56:9
segments: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:10
segments: In God (I will praise [his] word), In Jehovah (I will praise [his] word),

entries.title: Psalms 56:11
segments: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 56:12
segments: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 56:13
segments: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: [Hast thou] not [delivered] my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?
